people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Shechem
people.line: City in Canaan, later allotted to Ephraim

translations.web: They gave to Jacob all the foreign gods which were in their hands, and the rings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.
translations.bsb: So they gave Jacob all their foreign gods and all their earrings, and Jacob buried them under the oak near Shechem.
translations.kjv: And they gave unto Jacob all the strange gods which were in their hand, and all their earrings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.
translations.asv: And they gave unto Jacob all the foreign gods which were in their hand, and the rings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.
